paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.69 as of July 31, representing a decrease of 15.45% from the prior close and 33.22% over the last 22 trading sessions. The recent news is driven by Cetera Investment Advisers' increased holdings in Fermi Inc. and other developments such as the appointment of new officers, including George Wentz as General Counsel and Rob Masson as Chief Financial Officer, as disclosed in an 8-K filing on July 23. Additionally, there was the resignation of director Miles Everson, which was disclosed in 8-K filings on July 13 and July 21.

There have been various SEC filings, including an 8-K filing on July 15, which disclosed the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. The company has also filed a SCHEDULE 13G on July 20. There has been one Form 4 filing, and there are two new social posts in the last 24 hours, including a discussion thread on Fermi America.
